newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower for all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower for all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed sharply lower on Friday, as the weaker Chicago market triggered active selling orders from local investors, traders said.
Prices were 240 to 370 yen lower, with the benchmark January 1998 contract down 270 yen at 15,710 yen per tonne.
Local investors sold actively from the opening session, following the Chicago market's losses overnight, traders said.

Some months recovered somewhat later due to the yen's fall against the dollar during Tokyo trading, they said. The dollar powered its way above the 124 yen level, rising to 124.30 yen, a fresh four-year high, in Tokyo on Friday.
